# Notification banner

**Status:** Stable  
**Reviewed against:** GOV.UK Frontend 6.5.0 on 2026-09-09

Use the Notification banner to tell users about an important change or the successful result of an action.

## When to use

- Use for important information that applies to the current page or for a success message after an action.
- Put the banner after breadcrumbs or back link and before the main page heading.

## When not to use

- Do not use for validation errors; use the Error summary and inline Error message.
- Do not use instead of a confirmation page when the completed transaction needs a reference or durable record.

## Anatomy

- **Labelled region (required):** A region references the banner title with aria-labelledby.
- **Banner title (required):** A compact heading identifies an important or successful notification.
- **Content (required):** The content states the message and can include a relevant link.

## Variants

| Variant | Element | Classes | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Important | `div` | `govuk-notification-banner` | Important information that is not a success confirmation. |
| Success | `div` | `govuk-notification-banner`, `govuk-notification-banner--success` | Confirm a successful action on the next page. |

## Behaviour and progressive enhancement

- Initialise the govuk-notification-banner module; it manages focus for a success banner unless auto-focus is explicitly disabled.
- Render important information as a region and success feedback as an alert using the official macro options.
- The full message must remain available without client-side JavaScript.

## Accessibility contract

- Give every banner title a unique id and reference it from aria-labelledby.
- Use the success role and automatic focus sparingly so screen-reader users are notified without repeated interruptions.
- Keep links descriptive and make meaning independent of colour.

## Content rules

- Use “Important” for the default title and “Success” for a successful outcome unless a clearer short label is needed.
- Lead with what changed or what the user completed.
- Include only actions directly related to the notification.

## Token references

- `govuk.color.brand`
- `govuk.color.success`
- `govuk.color.text`
- `govuk.color.focus`

## HTML examples

### Important notification

```html
<div class="govuk-notification-banner" role="region" aria-labelledby="notice-title" data-module="govuk-notification-banner">
  <div class="govuk-notification-banner__header"><h2 class="govuk-notification-banner__title" id="notice-title">Important</h2></div>
  <div class="govuk-notification-banner__content"><p class="govuk-notification-banner__heading">Your application deadline has changed.</p></div>
</div>
```
